scope: Code-only. The first full-arm liveness run failed while auditing stored stock keys: the guarded ledger accepted the absolute-position table aliases but not the stored tensor alias deberta.embeddings.position_embeddings._weight, so it stopped before any optimizer step, dev prediction or verification. No data, protocol, model, seed, recipe, target, split or selection changed. The dataset bytes and protocol hash are untouched; only the two implementation files recorded below and the verifier gain an exclusion/custody entry.
cause: custody ledger omission of a stored safetensors alias for a table config.position_biased_input already disables; the loaded encoder omits all three aliases
not_a_result: No loss, gradient, delta, restore, cache, accuracy or interval was produced by the failed run; it earns nothing and is retained as evidence.
fix: native_field_model.py: added the stored _weight alias to inactive position keys, and required each such stored table to match [max_position_embeddings, hidden_size] from the pinned config.

native_field_data.py, native_field_train.py, native_field_verify.py: added a bounded committed execution-correction registry so pre-correction dataset custody, retained failed receipts and the exact prior receipt stay verifiable after a code-only change.
native_field_train.py: smoke reruns write to a distinct retained-suffix directory; training arm outputs are unchanged in name.
unchanged: dataset_manifest.json and all four phase files
